materials.name: 33N
materials.notes: Flame retardant polyimide laminate and prepreg. Tg above 250 C by TMA (the sheet gives no DSC value); initial decomposition 353 C and 5 % loss at 389 C; T260 above 60 min. Process: bake inner layers 60 min at 107-121 C; vacuum desiccate prepreg 8-12 h; pre-vacuum 30-45 min; heat rise 4.5-6.5 C/min between 100 and 150 C; cure at 213 C for 90 min (60 min for the first cycle of a sequential lamination); cool at 6 C/min or less; drill at 350 SFM, undercut bits for vias of 0.45 mm and below; bake 1-2 h at 121 C before HASL. Prepreg styles and flow are those of 85N (106, 1080, 2313, 2116, 7628). Lamination pressure 275-400 psi (non-vacuum) or 200-300 psi (vacuum) depending on panel size.
